text: Sit a while, sailor. The tide's in no hurry, and neither am I.
You can see me. Not many can, these days.
You're after the old crown's shards. I can hear them in your pack, singing to their sister. Mist comes out at night, child. So do I.
Kingsrest. I sailed there once, when it had a roof. Mind the throne; the last one who sat in it never got up.
Moon's on the water. That's when I walk.
Ah. Another one who doesn't sleep.
You carry the old stones. I can feel them from here, humming like a hive.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: What's that song you were humming?
Do you have anything for me?

text: I sailed with the first fleet that found these islands. That was a long time ago. Longer than you'd credit.
A name? I had one. I gave it to the sea in trade for something. I forget what.
Ghost is a heavy word. I'm a man the tide hasn't finished with. Same as you, if you sail long enough.
"Down where the lanterns drown, the bell rings slow..." You'll hear it in the taverns. They've got the words wrong.
The real last verse goes: 'and the sea gives back what the sea was owed.' Nobody sings that one anymore.

options.label: What does the sea want back?

text: Everything it lent. The islands, the ships, us.
Doesn't mean you can't make it wait.
Whirlpools at the Drain and the Churn: steer wide, or steer through dead centre at full sail. Nothing in between.
The fog off Blackveil isn't weather. Don't follow lights in it.
There's a city under the waves, west and south. Vesh Amaru. It drowned all at once, they say, in a single afternoon.

options.label: How do I reach the drowned city?

text: Find a diver. Buy a helmet. Go down where the reef goes dark and keep going.
There's a temple at the heart, and under the temple floor, more. Mind the guardians.
Go on, then. The night won't last, and neither will I.
